Scenario: Authenticated concurrent draw HTTP benchmark with isolated Campaign/Worker MySQL and Kafka

Environment.JavaVersion:
java version "17.0.12" 2024-07-16 LTS
Java(TM) SE Runtime Environment (build 17.0.12+8-LTS-286)
Java HotSpot(TM) 64-Bit Server VM (build 17.0.12+8-LTS-286, mixed mode, sharing)

Configuration.Warmup: Health GET, authenticated Campaign GET, and one authenticated invalid draw stopped by validation before timed batch (warms Redis/Lettuce when enabled)

FaultInjection.Recovery: Kafka broker restarted; Outbox and Worker completion are verified in the normal chain

Note: Local benchmark only; not production capacity evidence and not evidence that Redis makes MySQL faster.
